name: monday.com MCP
summary: monday.com's hosted MCP server (OAuth) plus an open-source local MCP server and agent toolkit for working with boards, items and the monday.com API.
description: Hosted endpoint `https://mcp.monday.com/mcp` with OAuth and workspace-level access controls; monday.com publishes setup guides for Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio and Mistral Le Chat. The MIT-licensed repo, maintained by the monday.com AI team, contains `@mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp` (npm 3.3.1; run locally with an API token) and `@mondaydotcomorg/agent-toolkit` for building agents against the monday.com API with OpenAI or MCP.

agent_access.notes: Hosted server uses OAuth; the self-hosted npm server uses a monday.com API token.
